title: Brun4o and Delatorvi Collaborate on New Single "Eu Tô Bem"
htmlContent:
Brazilian trap artist Brun4o has teamed up with Delatorvi, one of the pioneers of trap in Brazil, for his latest single, "Eu Tô Bem." The track features a beat by DJ Leonardo Rafael and production from AL$, showcasing Brun4o's authentic and robust catalog and growing influence in the Brazilian music scene.

With influences ranging from cloud rap and hip-hop to R&B and urban pop, "Eu Tô Bem" demonstrates Brun4o's versatility as an artist. The collaboration with Delatorvi highlights the strong connections between Brazilian trap artists and the intimate scene in Minas Gerais.

As Brun4o's career continues to gain momentum, "Eu Tô Bem" marks a new chapter in the artist's musical journey. With its infectious beat and memorable lyrics, the track will surely be a hit with Brazilian trap and hip-hop fans.
